sources.entry: Turbo Boost Switcher - Turbo Boost Switcher is a little application for Mac computers that allows to enable and/or disable the Turbo Boost feature.

summary.one_liner: Turbo Boost Switcher is a macOS status-bar app for Intel Macs that enables or disables the CPU Turbo Boost feature using a bundled kernel extension.
summary.what_it_does: The app installs a precompiled kernel extension (32 or 64 bit, depending on the system) that writes the Turbo Boost flag in the MSR register, and it asks for an admin password when toggling. It sits in the Mac status bar and shows whether Turbo Boost is currently enabled or disabled. Options include auto-disable on launch, restoring Turbo Boost on exit, and opening at login. It also displays CPU temperature, load and fan speed, with a configurable sensor update interval and charts of how temperature, fan speed, CPU load and frequency change with Turbo Boost status. The README says it is translated into English and Spanish, with other languages in beta. A PRO version is mentioned that adds automatic modes (CPU, temperature, battery, apps, displays) and uses a daemon so the app does not need root.
use_cases: disable CPU turbo boost to lower temperatures
toggle turbo boost on a mac
reduce mac fan noise under heavy load
monitor CPU temperature and fan speed from the menu bar
compare performance with turbo boost on and off
keep CPU cooler during video transcoding or photo editing
how_to_run: Download the binary application or clone the source code and compile it with Xcode.
Unzip the downloaded app and move it to another folder (required on macOS Sierra and later due to Translocation).
Double-click 'Turbo Boost Switcher.app' to run it.
On macOS High Sierra or later, allow the kernel extension in System Preferences > Security and Privacy the first time you disable Turbo Boost.
Enter your admin password when enabling or disabling Turbo Boost, or run the app with sudo to avoid repeated prompts.
notable: Toggles Intel Turbo Boost through a kernel extension that writes the MSR register
Status-bar app showing live Turbo Boost state, CPU temp, load and fan speed
Charts comparing temperature, fan speed and frequency with Turbo Boost on versus off
Optional PRO version with a daemon (no root needed) and automatic modes
caveats: Requires an Intel CPU with Turbo Boost; not applicable to Macs without it.
Needs admin or root privileges because it installs a kernel extension, and macOS may prompt for a root password.
Unsigned builds need Gatekeeper permission changes, and High Sierra+ needs manual kext approval; advanced auto modes and the daemon are in the paid PRO version.
keywords: turn off cpu boost on mac
